description: Catálogo modular de paquetes de firmas SIS para Snort.

packages.name: IEC-104
packages.description: Detección de actividad IEC-60870-5-104 en puerto 2404.
rules: alert tcp any any -> any 2404 (msg:"SIS IEC-104 APDU detectada"; content:"|68|"; depth:1; sid:1000001; rev:2;)
alert tcp any any -> any 2404 (msg:"SIS IEC-104 posible DoS SYN"; flags:S; sid:1000003; rev:2;)

packages.name: Modbus
packages.description: Firmas básicas para Modbus/TCP en puerto 502.
rules: alert tcp any any -> any 502 (msg:"SIS Modbus/TCP función write single coil"; content:"|00 05|"; offset:7; depth:2; sid:1000101; rev:1;)
alert tcp any any -> any 502 (msg:"SIS Modbus/TCP función write multiple registers"; content:"|00 10|"; offset:7; depth:2; sid:1000102; rev:1;)

packages.name: IEC-61850
rules: alert tcp any any -> any 102 (msg:"SIS IEC-61850/MMS tráfico detectado"; sid:1000201; rev:1;)

packages.name: Windows
packages.description: Indicadores comunes de movimiento lateral y administración Windows.
rules: alert tcp any any -> any 3389 (msg:"SIS Windows RDP conexión"; sid:1000301; rev:1;)
alert tcp any any -> any 5985 (msg:"SIS Windows WinRM HTTP"; sid:1000302; rev:1;)

packages.name: Linux
packages.description: Firmas de administración remota y patrones Linux/Unix.
rules: alert tcp any any -> any 22 (msg:"SIS Linux SSH conexión"; sid:1000401; rev:1;)
alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"SIS Linux posible comando shell"; content:"/bin/sh"; nocase; sid:1000402; rev:1;)

packages.name: Web
packages.description: Patrones web básicos: SQLi, paths sensibles y explotación genérica.
rules: alert tcp any any -> any $HTTP_PORTS (msg:"SIS Web SQL injection básica"; content:"union select"; nocase; sid:1000501; rev:1;)
alert tcp any any -> any $HTTP_PORTS (msg:"SIS Web acceso a /etc/passwd"; content:"/etc/passwd"; nocase; sid:1000502; rev:1;)
alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"SIS exploit genérico detectado"; content:"exploit"; nocase; sid:1000002; rev:2;)

packages.name: DNS
packages.description: Consultas DNS sospechosas y dominios de prueba.
rules: alert udp any any -> any 53 (msg:"SIS DNS consulta sospechosa .onion"; content:"|05|onion"; nocase; sid:1000601; rev:1;)
alert udp any any -> any 53 (msg:"SIS DNS posible túnel largo"; dsize:>200; sid:1000602; rev:1;)

packages.name: SMB
packages.description: Uso de SMB/CIFS y posibles accesos a shares administrativos.
rules: alert tcp any any -> any 445 (msg:"SIS SMB conexión"; sid:1000701; rev:1;)
alert tcp any any -> any 445 (msg:"SIS SMB acceso ADMIN$"; content:"ADMIN$"; nocase; sid:1000702; rev:1;)

packages.name: Otros
packages.description: Firmas base de conectividad y demostración.
rules: alert icmp any any -> any any (msg:"[TEST] Ping Detectado en WiFi"; sid:1000005; rev:2;)

profiles.description: IEC-104, IEC-61850, Modbus y reglas base para subestaciones/SCADA.
